scope: Source/VM card and interaction checks only; no native rendered geometry, keyboard or smoothness certification.
reveal_reservation: Sealed slots contain inert, aria-hidden intrinsic card reservations. Fixed maximum heights removed, with matching minimum frames. Source arrangement is checked, geometry is not measured.
native_controls: Native Select club buttons, club-specific accessible labels, aria-pressed and visible selected text; whole-card focus-within outline.

foundation.scope: Real cricket engine + new UI dispatch in a VM DOM stub. No browser, visual, geometry, focus or latency certification.

markup.scope: Parsed HTML strings from the VM DOM stub; does not validate geometry or visual quality.

foundation_markup.scope: Parsed HTML strings from the VM DOM stub; does not validate geometry or visual quality.

reveal.scope: VM clock and command tests; proves reveal sequencing/save guards and unchanged draw order, not rendered smoothness.
